name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add a 4px solid focus ring in #005fcc to every interactive element. This ensures keyboard users see where they are, meeting WCAG 2.2 AA for focus visibility. The trade-off is a slight visual bump in crowded UIs, but it’s a one-time cost for universal access.

name: Reader
text: A 4px solid ring in #005fcc fails on patterned or dark backgrounds—it creates a muddy halo that blends with texture, breaking contrast. Instead, use a 2px ring with 3px outer glow in #005fcc on light backgrounds and invert it on dark; test with WCAG 2.1 contrast checker. Settle it with a 5-minute Playwright MCP test scanning 20 random interactive elements across 3 background types.
